title: Mixed Event — Nocturne Interlude — Episode8 The Light I Grasped

meta.Event Outline: Toya has decided to create street music as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD. But something happens to make him wonder if classical music still has some hold on him, leading to some self-doubt...

rows.Line: After the event
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Bye, dad. Please be careful on your way back.
I'll head back after we wrap things up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming to watch us today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your father's so understanding, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you for talking to him with me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And it's been a while since I'd seen Akito's good guy facade.
Talk about putting up a front, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just trying to avoid unnecessary drama.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So... What about your dad, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I didn't see him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it's fine.
I already know what I'm going to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll keep walking down this path I've chosen.
It doesn't matter what he says anymore.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. And you were awesome today, Toya.
I got a huge rush just singing next to you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like you went from being just a steady support to a force that pushes us to do better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I can work with that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for me, I expected nothing less from my partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dude, you could barely keep it in back there. I mean, who was the guy ruffling Toya's hair after getting so excited?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, do you have eyes in the back of your head or something...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should tell everyone in SEKAI about this too. Especially Miku, since she made me realize something very important.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And thank you, everyone.
I'm really glad I talked to you about this.
Aoyagi Household - Living Room
se_event_nocturne_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: What took you so long...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't help getting back late on event nights. However, I'll try to let you know in advance from now on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good night.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I... I can't understand what people see in that sort of music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sort of music...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, were you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I still have work to do.
Go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He did come to see us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I guess he still doesn't understand yet but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, dad...
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There, done...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heeey! We're here for some fun!
MEIKO, I feel like hot chocolate today♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As you wish, Rin.
What about you, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll have hot chocolate too!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku, when did you get this planter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, it's not a planter. It's actually a cup.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We can't use it as a cup because it has a crack in it, but I thought that if we put a saucer below it like this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! The way it leaks is the same as having drainage holes. That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But you're growing grass instead of flowers?
What kind of grass is that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's an herb called Thyme. Kohane suggested it when I was talking to everyone the other day. We can even use it to make herbal teas.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Apparently, Thyme also symbolizes courageous action...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Courageous action, you say?
That sounds just like them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I hope Toya is doing okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sure he's fine!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, here they come!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, there!
Thanks for dropping by again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! Len and Rin are here too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Everyone's here!
Come in and make yourselves at home!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Make yourself at home? This isn't your cafe, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, that doesn't mean I can't say it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can you two bicker about something like that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean everything went well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I came to let you know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm?
Was this planter here before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup. There was a cup with a crack in it.
So we turned it into a planter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As long as it isn't completely broken, you can always use it for something else as long as you don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As long as it isn't completely broken, huh...?
I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You know, I feel like I could sing really well right now. Do you mind if I sing something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why not? I see no reason to object.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're gonna sing? You can't say that without letting me join in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What? Akito's gonna sing?
Then I wanna sing too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too, me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Get in line, you two.
We're singing first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aww... Why can't we all just sing together?
